3. REMOVE CALIPER
Remove the 2 mounting bolts and caliper.
Torque: 118 N·m (1,200 kgf·cm, 87 ft·lbf)

4. REMOVE THESE PARTS:
(a) Clip
(b) 2 pins
(c) Anti–rattle spring
(d) 2 pads
(e) 2 pad spacers
(f) 2 anti–squeal shims

CALIPER DISASSEMBLY

Assembly is in the reverse order of disassembly.
ASSEMBLY NOTICE: Apply lithium soap base glycol grease to the parts indicated by the arrows (See page BR–22).

1. REMOVE CYLINDER BOOT SET RINGS AND BOOTS
Using a screwdriver, remove the 4 cylinder boot set rings and 4 boots.

2. REMOVE PISTONS FROM CYLINDER
(a) Prepare a wooden plate to hold the pistons.

(b) Place the plate between the pistons and insert a pad on one side.
(c) Use compressed air to remove the pistons alternately from the cylinder.
DISASSEMBLY CAUTION: Do not place your fingers in front of the pistons when using compressed air.

3. REMOVE PISTON SEALS
Using a screwdriver, remove the 4 piston seals from the cylinder.
